name: Of Heart and Stone
source:
Sekyr and Thorn, a burly bear monk and a fox rogue, head out on their last adventure and find out what they really mean to each other.

[From [url=https://solharries.itch.io/of-heart-and-stone]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
塞基尔和索恩（一个魁梧的熊和尚和一个狐狸盗贼）踏上了最后的冒险之旅，并找出他们对彼此的真正意义。

[来自[url=https://solharries.itch.io/of-heart-and-stone]Itch.io[/url]]
